class.name: TextLocalizationServer
class.brief_description: Translates texts with context, plural forms and placeholders from [TextLocalizationCatalog]s.

method.name: get_key_id
method.description: Returns the id of [param key] in [param context] for [method translate_id], or [code]-1[/code] if no catalog has the key. An id stays valid for the lifetime of the server, also across locale and catalog changes.

method.name: get_missing_keys
method.description: Returns the keys that have no text in [param locale] or its parent locales, so they show the text of the fallback locale or the key. An empty [param locale] means the locale of each key's channel. Meant for tools and tests: it reads every key.

method.name: get_translation_keys
method.description: Returns all keys whose text in the active locale chain is [param text].

method.name: has_translation
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param key] in [param context] has a text in the active locale chain, including the fallback locale.

method.name: translate
method.description: Returns the text of [param key] in [param context] for the active locale chain. With [param count] of [code]0[/code] or more, the plural form for [param count] is chosen by the plural rule of the locale the text comes from. With a non-empty [param args], placeholders are filled (see [TextInsertionServer]). Without a text, the key is returned, with its placeholders filled too.

method.name: translate_for_locale
method.description: Like [method translate], for the chain of [param locale] without changing the active locale. For another locale the catalogs are read directly (at most one read per chain locale and layer); a locale of a [code].lcat[/code] catalog is loaded on demand.

method.name: translate_id
method.description: Like [method translate], for an id returned by [method get_key_id]. The fastest way to translate: one array read, no hashing of the key.

signal.name: key_missing
signal.description: Emitted in debug builds when [method translate] or [method translate_id] finds no text for [param key] in the chain of [param locale]. Emitted once per key and locale; calls through [method Object.tr] do not emit it.
